_source: LA County Public Works sign records use Caltrans object marker types as codes: T + type letter (N, K, Q, P, R, L) + county variant number. Read from the codes (TP1R/TP1L are right/left Type P), the CA MUTCD 2026 (Sections 2C.70 and 3G.03, Figure 2C-17(CA)) and street photos at the recorded locations. The meaning of the variant number is not published.

tn.name: Object marker, Type N (CA)
tn.note: Yellow diamond object marker in street photos at these records; face shown is the closest standard (OM1).

tk.name: Object marker, Type K (CA), 18 inch flexible marker
tk.note: Used with delineators at islands, ramps and connectors (CA MUTCD Figure 3G-102(CA)).

tq.name: Tubular object marker, Type Q (CA)
tq.note: Vertical tube 18 to 24 inches tall with yellow retroreflective bands; marks curb noses and objects in the roadway (CA MUTCD 2C.70, Figure 2C-17(CA)).

tl.name: Utility pole marker, Type L (CA)
tl.note: Three 2 x 12 inch yellow bands on a utility pole (CA MUTCD 2C.70, Figure 2C-17(CA)).
